propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process; every other host's snapshot store is append-only and never reclaimed, causing unbounded growth (observed: 47.24 GiB with 64,021 entries).

Operation-linked GC trigger mirrors compact_trigger pattern: O(1) in-process check on gate-resolution tail, heavy reclamation work in detached child, stamped worker-lock sidecar keyed on snapshot store root to avoid blocking the gate or ticket-store lock.

Trigger calls maybe_gc on resolve_gate_handle tail (attested handles only, never-raise); when due per janitor interval_seconds cadence, spawns detached gc child with durable cwd at store root and stdio logged under <store>/gc/.

Single-flight lock adjudication: detached child re-acquires stamped worker.lock (stale reclamation via stamped_file_is_stale); run_gc's existing gc flock prevents overlap; stand-aside returns skipped=locked without resetting stamp, so review-bot resident janitor is unregressed.
Trigger is operation-linked and in-process (no CI provider, cron, or daemon); quiet path is O(1) with no store enumeration and no ticket-store lock acquire.
